dialogue.speaker: Sari
dialogue.text: Halo, silakan duduk. Apa yang membawa Anda ke sini hari ini?
dialogue.en: Hello, please sit down. What brings you here today?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Saya demam dan batuk parah sudah tiga hari.
dialogue.en: I have had a fever and a bad cough for three days.

dialogue.speaker: Sari
dialogue.text: Apakah Anda punya gejala lain, seperti nyeri di dada?
dialogue.en: Do you have any other symptoms, like pain in your chest?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Tidak nyeri, tetapi saya merasa sangat lemas dan tidak bisa tidur nyenyak.
dialogue.en: No pain, but I feel very weak and I cannot sleep well.

dialogue.speaker: Sari
dialogue.text: Biar saya periksa paru-paru Anda. Tarik napas dalam-dalam, ya.
dialogue.en: Let me listen to your lungs. Please breathe deeply.

dialogue.speaker: Sari
dialogue.text: Tidak, ini hanya flu berat. Anda perlu beristirahat paling sedikit lima hari.
dialogue.en: No, it is just a strong flu. You need to rest for at least five days.

dialogue.speaker: Sari
dialogue.text: Saya akan memberi resep untuk demamnya. Minumlah banyak air juga.
dialogue.en: I will give you a prescription for the fever. Drink a lot of water, too.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Berapa lama sampai saya pulih sepenuhnya?
dialogue.en: How long will it take to recover completely?

dialogue.speaker: Sari
dialogue.text: Sekitar seminggu. Datang lagi untuk janji temu berikutnya kalau memburuk.
dialogue.en: About a week. Come back for another appointment if it gets worse.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Terima kasih, Dok. Saya akan mengikuti saran Anda.
dialogue.en: Thank you, doctor. I will follow your advice.
